name: Cloudflare Workers AI
setup_instructions:
1. Create a Cloudflare account at https://dash.cloudflare.com/sign-up/workers-and-pages (no card required).
2. Copy your Account ID from the Cloudflare dashboard.
3. Create a Workers AI API token with Workers AI - Read and Workers AI - Edit permissions at https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens (or via the Workers AI page -> Use REST API).
4. Set CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID and CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY (the token) in your client and point an OpenAI-compatible client at https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/${CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID}/ai/v1.
